description: This file defines the VoiceSessionCoordinator class, which manages voice recognition sessions in a macOS application. It handles starting, updating, finalizing, sending, and dismissing voice sessions, interacts with overlays, and manages session state.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for orchestrating voice recognition sessions, including session lifecycle management and UI interaction.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice session with specified source and text, returns a session token.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial transcribed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the session with complete text and additional parameters like sendChime and autoSendAfter.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Immediately sends the current session's text for processing.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session with a specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates voice level feedback for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session token, text, and visibility status of overlay.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles overlay dismiss event and clears session if applicable.
